description: This file is the __init__.py for the torch.fx package, containing imports, symbol exports, and documentation for the FX toolkit components.

classes.name: Graph
classes.description: Represents the high-level intermediate representation (IR) of a traced module.

classes.name: GraphModule
classes.description: Wraps a Graph object into a torch.nn.Module with a generated forward method.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in the IR graph, corresponding to a function call, module call, or input/output.

classes.name: Proxy
classes.description: A proxy object used during symbolic tracing to record operations.

methods.name: symbolic_trace
methods.description: Performs symbolic tracing of a torch.nn.Module to produce a GraphModule.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Utility to wrap functions for symbolic tracing.

methods.name: replace_pattern
methods.description: Replaces subgraphs matching a pattern within a Graph.
